name: Comarch S.A.
summary: Comarch S.A. designs, implements, and integrates IT solutions worldwide. Its solutions include Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity and solution management, analytics platform, and billing system; digital sales and customer care, and real time data control and presentation; B2B self-enablement platform, and sales and ordering; enterprise billing, charging, and revenue management; network provisioning, real time OSS-SDN/NFV orchestration, self-organizing network, and intelligent assurance and analytics; inventory management, network planning and design, auto-discovery and reconciliation, configuration management, and network consolidation; and professional services. The company also provides small business and corporate banking, factoring, trade finance, wealth management, digital insurance, anti-money laundering, identity and access management, transaction protection, and ERP solutions. In addition, it offers ERGO supporting system; platform that supports electronic and paper flow of documents; e-Office, an online public service platform; ERP class integrated IT system; smart parking; security platform; eRecording; and video terminal solutions. Further, the company provides loyalty programs, marketing campaign management, employee motivation management, electronic data interchange, business information, document management, sales process management support systems, and mobile applications. Additionally, it offers solutions for IT systems for hospitals; software products for health record management in medical facilities; IOT solutions and its components; short series manufacturing of electronics; services for the automotive industry, such as software development, infotainment in-car, integration with smartphones, e-mobility, and UX/UI; certification tools; embedded systems; and outsourcing solutions. The company is also involved in the sports activities. Comarch S.A. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Kraków, Poland.
